detailed_descriptions.en: WANTED: MANAGER FOR AN ABANDONED WAREHOUSE WITH POTENTIAL! The year is 2037. You have a small warehouse, a mountain of packages, and big dreams. Sort the boxes and deliver orders to customers. Then hire robots and... make sure they don't mess up. CAN'T WRITE A SYMPHONY BUT CAN DELIVER BOXES At first, it's all on you: you take deliveries, sort the goods, and make sure customers aren't kept waiting. Try to handle at least some of it. But as soon as you buy robots that work 24/7, life at the warehouse will become much more interesting. Automate processes and watch the warehouse grow. Analyze the warehouse's needs and purchase the right robots. MORE WAREHOUSE SPACE. MORE MONEY. MORE COMPETITION Big order? Load up the van. Urgent delivery? Send out a drone. Build a business that operates efficiently on the ground and in the air. BUSINESS RULE #1: NO RULES Your competitors want money, too. Flood the city with ads, poach key customers, and snag the most lucrative VIP orders on the black market. You'll need to operate at night, without leaving any traces: the FBI doesn't like packages like these. INFINITY IS NO LIMIT WHEN YOU HAVE A ROCKET! And when the city starts to feel too small for you—start building a rocket for deliveries on a cosmic scale! You won't just be serving humans.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
WANTED: MANAGER FOR AN ABANDONED WAREHOUSE WITH POTENTIAL!

The year is 2037. You have a small warehouse, a mountain of packages, and big dreams. Sort the boxes and deliver orders to customers. Then hire robots and... make sure they don't mess up.

CAN'T WRITE A SYMPHONY BUT CAN DELIVER BOXES

At first, it's all on you: you take deliveries, sort the goods, and make sure customers aren't kept waiting. Try to handle at least some of it. But as soon as you buy robots that work 24/7, life at the warehouse will become much more interesting. Automate processes and watch the warehouse grow. Analyze the warehouse's needs and purchase the right robots.

MORE WAREHOUSE SPACE. MORE MONEY. MORE COMPETITION

Big order? Load up the van. Urgent delivery? Send out a drone. Build a business that operates efficiently on the ground and in the air.

BUSINESS RULE #1: NO RULES

Your competitors want money, too. Flood the city with ads, poach key customers, and snag the most lucrative VIP orders on the black market. You'll need to operate at night, without leaving any traces: the FBI doesn't like packages like these.

INFINITY IS NO LIMIT WHEN YOU HAVE A ROCKET!

And when the city starts to feel too small for you—start building a rocket for deliveries on a cosmic scale! You won't just be serving humans.
